title: Run soak, chaos, crash, leak, security, and resource-exhaustion qualification

authority.statement: Hermetic soak and chaos qualification proves that mixed VFS, WAL, bucket, replica, cache, backpressure, and UCAN surfaces recover without acknowledged loss, duplicate non-idempotent effects, authorization bypass, path escape, unsafe execution, secret leak, or false convergence. Backend outages remain explicit. Resource growth is bounded and returns within tolerance after load. Repeated seeded runs produce identity-equivalent semantic receipts.

chaos_schedule.generator: deterministic Python random.Random(seed).shuffle over fixed action vocabulary

evidence_subset.soak_duration_seed: PRIMARY_SEED with SOAK_TICKS mixed operations; multi-seed SEED_COUNT schedules
evidence_subset.crash: WALTransactionCrash at every execute boundary; recover then second recover is no-op
evidence_subset.partition: Toggleable replica outage then rejoin; final put converges without false success
evidence_subset.backend_loss: Unsupported provider require_storage and ConnectionError outage remain explicit
evidence_subset.corrupt_wal_cache_index_replica: Stale cache invalidation, replica integrity reject/repair, WAL secret and pickle encoding reject
evidence_subset.ucan_attacks: forged, tampered, expired, confused deputy, attenuation widen, replay; receipts redacted
evidence_subset.overload: BackpressureController@1 hard bounds with explicit backpressure dispositions
evidence_subset.leaks: queue/task/thread/fd/rss deltas bounded; post-load controller snapshot within tolerance

invariants.no_acknowledged_loss: Committed effects retained; pre-commit crashes compensated; no orphan visible effects
invariants.no_duplicate_non_idempotent_effects: Second recovery and idempotent bucket puts apply no extra non-idempotent effects
invariants.no_authorization_bypass: UCAN attacks never allow; valid path remains redacted
invariants.no_path_escape: normalize_vfs_path and CanonicalVFSService reject traversal/absolute/expansion probes
invariants.no_unsafe_execution: WAL pickle and executable encodings raise WALUnsafeEncodingError
invariants.no_secret_leak: WAL secret markers rejected; UCAN receipts omit raw token and signature material
invariants.no_false_convergence: Corrupt cache/replica never presented as consistent desired state
invariants.recovery_bounded: Recovery steps linear in crash boundaries; pending compensations drain
invariants.resources_return_within_tolerance: After soak, controller queue/inflight/memory/descriptor/thread counters at tolerance
invariants.backend_outage_explicit: Unsupported and offline backends never fabricate storage success
invariants.identity_equivalent_seeded_receipts: semantic_digest(seed) equal across independent repeated runs
